description: Send large files by link, with an expiry date and an optional password. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded, at most 35000000 characters (three quarters of that in bytes). The file is stored in the caller's account, counts against its storage quota, and must be within the plan's per-file limit.

duration.description: How long the link works for anyone who has it: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y. The 90d and 1y options are Pro durations; there is no permanent one, and a link never outlives the stored file. Each call stores a new copy and mints a new link, so call once per file.

message.description: A short note shown beside the file to whoever opens the link. Plain text: line breaks are collapsed, it is shortened, and URLs in it are not made clickable.

name.description: The filename, with extension, that the recipient sees and downloads. Cleaned of unsafe characters before storage.

password.description: A password the recipient must type to open the link, at least 4 characters. Only a salted hash is stored. Omit it, or send an empty string, for no password.

screen.description: Have a model check the image for explicit content before the link is made. Images only, costs one AI credit from the caller's monthly allowance, and if the image is judged explicit no link is created at all.

senderName.description: Who the file is from, shown as a heading to whoever opens the link. Plain text: trimmed, shortened, and never turned into a link.

type.description: The file's MIME type, such as "image/png" or "application/pdf". It is served with this type, and only an image type can be screened.

name: share_file
title: Share a File
